items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 14 at 8:35PM CST until November 16 at 3:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Chambers; Inland Jackson; Inland Matagorda; Inland Brazoria; Inland Galveston; Coastal Harris; Coastal Jackson; Coastal Matagorda; Coastal Brazoria; Coastal Galveston
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 25 mph with gusts up to 35 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Jackson, Inland Jackson, Chambers, Coastal
Brazoria, Coastal Galveston, Coastal Harris, Coastal Matagorda,
Inland Brazoria, Inland Galveston, and Inland Matagorda Counties.

* WHEN...From 9 AM Sunday to 3 PM CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued November 14 at 11:04PM CST until November 16 at 6:00AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 20 to 25 knots through early Sunday afternoon,
becoming northeast 25 to 30 knots gusting 35 knots late Sunday
afternoon into Sunday night. Lower bay may gust over 40 knots at
times. Bay waters becoming very rough.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay.

* WHEN...For the first Small Craft Advisory, until 3 PM CST
Sunday. For the Gale Warning, from 3 PM Sunday to 6 AM CST
Monday. For the second Small Craft Advisory, from 6 AM to 3 PM
CST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Heavy showers and thunderstorms likely
Sunday. Cannot rule out locally higher winds and waterspouts.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
